title: Cedfin or Tŷ Mawr surveyed

cast.I_NIA: Nia, the archivist, in a 'paper' interlude stepping between the 1824 estate office and the modern reading room

shots.direction: Wide on the Bute estate office in Cardiff, 1824; the agent unrolls a large bound survey volume across an oak table while Nia, in modern dress and cotton gloves, steps up beside him.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal 1824 Cardiff estate office, dark oak panelling, tall sash window with grey morning light, oak table with a large open bound survey volume of hand-coloured field plans, brass inkwell and quill, candle sconce; E_AGENT in his 50s, pale, clean-shaven, thin-rimmed spectacles, black 1820s frock coat and high white stock, leather document case at his elbow; I_NIA, 30s Welsh woman, black bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan, white cotton archive gloves, standing beside him; no text in image, no crests, no coats of arms, no heraldry

lines.en: Bore da, Miss Nia. Mind the ink, it's still drying. This is Mr David Stewart's survey of the Bute estates, eighteen twenty-four. Plan nineteen.
lines.cy: Bore da, Miss Nia. Gofal efo'r inc, mae'n dal yn wlyb. Dyma arolwg Mr David Stewart o ystadau Bute, un wyth dau pedwar. Cynllun un naw.
lines.es: Buenos días, Miss Nia. Cuidado con la tinta, aún se seca. Es el plano de Mr David Stewart de las fincas Bute, mil ochocientos veinticuatro. Plano diecinueve.

shots.direction: Overhead insert on the open page of plan nineteen as Nia's gloved finger traces the heading.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal overhead close-up of an 1824 hand-drawn and watercolour-washed estate field plan in a bound survey volume, field boundaries in ink, woodland shaded green, hedgerows, a farmstead block, a gloved finger resting on the margin; handwriting rendered as illegible strokes, no readable text in image, no heraldry

lines.en: Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm. Two names for one farm, side by side. Today the Glamorgan Archives catalogue files it as Cedfin alias Ty Mawr farm, in Llandough, reference D B E one to two.
lines.cy: Cedfin neu Fferm Tŷ Mawr. Dau enw am un fferm, ochr yn ochr. Heddiw mae Archifau Morgannwg yn ei gofnodi fel Cedfin alias Tŷ Mawr farm, yn Llandochau, cyfeirnod D B E un i ddau.
lines.es: Cedfin o Ty Mawr Farm. Dos nombres para una finca, lado a lado. Hoy el archivo de Glamorgan la cataloga como Cedfin alias Ty Mawr farm, en Llandough, referencia D B E uno a dos.

shots.prop: Glamorgan Archives DB/E/1, plan 19 'Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm' (EV-0211 page)

shots.direction: Talking close-up of the agent reading the acreage from the plan's reference table.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of E_AGENT, 50s, pale, clean-shaven, thin-rimmed spectacles, 1820s black frock coat and white stock, reading from an open survey volume by window light in a panelled Cardiff estate office, 1824; no text, no heraldry

lines.en: One hundred and thirty-nine acres, three roods, eight perches. Of that, twenty acres, two roods and thirty-five perches is woodland.
lines.cy: Cant tri deg naw erw, tair rwd, wyth perc. O hynny, mae ugain erw, dwy rwd a phymtheg ar hugain o berc yn goedwig.
lines.es: Ciento treinta y nueve acres, tres roods, ocho perches. De eso, veinte acres, dos roods y treinta y cinco perches son bosque.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia leaning in to the occupier's name, frowning at the handwriting.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of I_NIA, 30s Welsh woman, black bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan, white cotton gloves, leaning over an 1820s survey volume in a dark-panelled office lit by a tall window; no text, no heraldry

lines.en: And the occupier? I read that hand as John Gedrick, but I'd want a second pair of eyes on those letters.
lines.cy: A'r deiliad? Dw i'n darllen y llawysgrifen yna fel John Gedrick, ond fe hoffwn i gael ail barau o lygaid ar y llythrennau yna.
lines.es: ¿Y el ocupante? Leo ese nombre como John Gedrick, pero quisiera otro par de ojos sobre esas letras.

shots.direction: Insert on a corner of the plan where a small added parcel is washed in a different tint; the agent's finger taps it.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal macro of a corner of an 1824 watercolour estate plan showing a small field parcel washed in a slightly different tint and joined to a larger holding, ink boundary lines, a man's finger in a black frock-coat cuff tapping it; illegible handwriting only, no readable text, no heraldry

lines.en: Gedrick, near enough. And mark this corner: ten acres, three roods, thirty-nine perches of late Thos. Williams land, added in.
lines.cy: Gedrick, go agos. A nodwch y gornel yma: deg erw, tair rwd, tri deg naw perc o dir diweddar Thos. Williams, wedi'i ychwanegu.
lines.es: Gedrick, más o menos. Y marque esta esquina: diez acres, tres roods, treinta y nueve perches de tierra que fue de Thos. Williams, sumada aquí.

shots.prop: DB/E/1 plan 19, detail: 10a 3r 39p 'late Thos. Williams' land (EV-0211)

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia, thoughtful, looking up from the plan toward the agent.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of I_NIA, black bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan, cotton gloves, thoughtful expression, soft window light in an 1824 oak-panelled estate office, survey volume blurred in foreground; no text, no heraldry

lines.en: A Williams on this ground in eighteen twenty-four. The plan shows his land joined to Ty Mawr. It doesn't show who he was, or how it came across.
lines.cy: Williams ar y tir yma yn un wyth dau pedwar. Mae'r cynllun yn dangos ei dir e'n uno â Thŷ Mawr. Dyw e ddim yn dangos pwy oedd e, na sut daeth e drosodd.
lines.es: Un Williams en este terreno en mil ochocientos veinticuatro. El plano muestra su tierra unida a Ty Mawr. No muestra quién era, ni cómo pasó a manos de Ty Mawr.

shots.direction: Cut to the modern archive reading room: Nia at her desk with a printed image of an old map beside a laptop.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal modern county records office reading room, pale wood desks, foam book supports, green-shaded lamp, I_NIA in mustard cardigan and tortoiseshell glasses seated with a large printout of an old hand-drawn farm map beside a closed laptop and pencil; no readable text, no heraldry

lines.en: The family wiki holds an uploaded picture titled eighteen twenty-four map of Ty Mawr. Nobody has pinned down who drew it, its scale, its sheet, where the original lives, or whether eighteen twenty-four is even the map's own date.
lines.cy: Mae wiki'r teulu'n dal llun wedi'i lwytho o'r enw map Tŷ Mawr un wyth dau pedwar. Does neb wedi cadarnhau pwy wnaeth ei dynnu, ei raddfa, ei daflen, lle mae'r gwreiddiol yn byw, na hyd yn oed os taw un wyth dau pedwar yw dyddiad y map ei hun.
lines.es: El wiki familiar tiene una imagen subida titulada mapa de mil ochocientos veinticuatro de Ty Mawr. Nadie ha establecido quién lo dibujó, su escala, su hoja, dónde está el original, ni si esa fecha es la del mapa mismo.

shots.prop: EV-0004 'Map of Ty Mawr dated 1824' (uploaded image)

shots.direction: Back in 1824, medium two-shot: the agent slides the printout beside plan nineteen; Nia nods.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal medium two-shot in an 1824 Cardiff estate office: E_AGENT in frock coat and spectacles laying a loose modern printout of an old map beside an open bound survey plan, I_NIA in mustard cardigan and cotton gloves beside him, warm window light, oak table, quill and inkwell; no readable text, no heraldry

lines.en: Then lay it beside plan nineteen, madam, and let the lines settle it.
lines.cy: Yna rhowch e wrth ymyl cynllun un naw, madam, a gadael i'r llinellau benderfynu.
lines.es: Entonces póngalo junto al plano diecinueve, señora, y que las líneas lo resuelvan.

lines.en: Exactly. Until they're matched, it's a picture, not proof of any boundary registered later.
lines.cy: Yn gywir. Nes iddyn nhw gael eu paru, llun yw e, nid prawf o unrhyw ffin a gofrestrwyd wedyn.
lines.es: Exacto. Hasta que coincidan, es solo una imagen, no prueba de ningún límite registrado después.

shots.direction: Insert on a second map printout on the reading-room desk, tithe-style field numbering faint and unreadable.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal overhead of a printout of a 19th-century parish-style field map with numbered field parcels (numbers illegible), lying on a pale wood reading-room desk next to a pencil and white cotton gloves; no readable text, no heraldry

lines.en: Then this one, saved in the media library as eighteen forty-one map. No title we can trust, no survey date, no archive number.
lines.cy: Yna hwn, wedi'i gadw yn y llyfrgell gyfryngau fel map un wyth pedwar un. Dim teitl i'w drystio, dim dyddiad arolwg, dim rhif archif.
lines.es: Luego esta, guardada en la biblioteca de medios como mapa de mil ochocientos cuarenta y uno. Sin título confiable, sin fecha de relevamiento, sin número de archivo.

shots.prop: EV-0005 historical map labelled '1841-map' (media library image)

shots.direction: Talking close-up of the agent, eyebrows raised, a dry half-smile.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of E_AGENT, pale, clean-shaven, thin-rimmed spectacles, 1820s frock coat and white stock, eyebrows raised in dry amusement, oak panelling behind, 1824 Cardiff estate office; no text, no heraldry

lines.en: Seventeen years after Mr Stewart? Then the tithe men will have been busy in Llandough.
lines.cy: Un deg saith mlynedd ar ôl Mr Stewart? Yna bydd dynion y degwm wedi bod yn brysur yn Llandochau.
lines.es: ¿Diecisiete años después de Mr Stewart? Entonces los diezmeros habrán estado ocupados en Llandough.

shots.direction: Slow push-in as Nia lifts a grey archive box onto the reading-room desk.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal modern records office reading room, I_NIA in mustard cardigan, tortoiseshell glasses and cotton gloves placing a grey archive box onto a desk beside foam supports, soft overhead light; no readable labels, no heraldry

lines.en: They were. The eighteen forty-one tithe apportionment for Llandough, Cogan and Leckwith survives as the parish copy, Glamorgan Archives P thirty-five stroke ten.
lines.cy: Oedden nhw. Mae cyfran degwm un wyth pedwar un Llandochau, Cogan a Llecwydd yn goroesi fel copi'r plwyf, Archifau Morgannwg P tri pump stroc deg.
lines.es: Así fue. El reparto de diezmos de mil ochocientos cuarenta y uno para Llandough, Cogan y Leckwith sobrevive como la copia parroquial, Glamorgan Archives P treinta y cinco barra diez.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia, gloved hands resting on the archive box, direct and careful.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of I_NIA, black bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan, gloved hands resting on a grey archive box, modern reading room softly blurred behind; no text, no heraldry

lines.en: But nothing yet ties this image to that apportionment, and neither picture proves ownership, possession or any conveyance.
lines.cy: Ond does dim byd eto'n cysylltu'r ddelwedd yma â'r gyfran honno, a dyw'r un o'r ddau lun yn profi perchnogaeth, meddiant na throsglwyddiad.
lines.es: Pero nada liga aún esta imagen a ese reparto, y ninguna de las dos imágenes prueba propiedad, posesión ni ninguna transferencia.

shots.direction: Wide: the agent closes the survey volume and buckles his document case; through the window, the green slope of Llandough hill in the distance; Nia turns to go.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal wide of an 1824 Cardiff estate office at late morning, E_AGENT in frock coat closing a large bound survey volume and buckling a leather document case, I_NIA in mustard cardigan turning toward the door, tall sash window showing distant green hills and woodland above a river valley; no text, no crests, no heraldry

lines.en: Then you'll be wanting the apportionment itself.
lines.cy: Yna byddwch chi am gael y gyfran ei hun.
lines.es: Entonces querrá ver el reparto mismo.

lines.en: First thing tomorrow. Let's follow those Williamses forward and see when Great House farm turns up in print.
lines.cy: Peth cyntaf fory. Gadewch i ni ddilyn y Williamsiaid yna ymlaen a gweld pryd mae fferm Great House yn ymddangos mewn print.
lines.es: Mañana a primera hora. Sigamos a esos Williams hacia adelante y veamos cuándo aparece Great House farm por escrito.

continuity: Nia sets off to follow the Williams name forward; next frame Gwen reads the 1904 Cardiff Times on John Williams succeeding his father in 1855 and Amy Williams's death at Great House farm.
